title: Some Principles for Making a Good Product
excerpt: Some principles I follow when creating — put yourself in the user's shoes, approach as an outsider, care for every detail, improve step by step, and mind how the work presents itself.
excerpt_zh: 把创作时的几条心法记下来：把自己当作使用它的用户，以外部人员的视角来使用产品，关注每一个角落，逐步变好而不求一步到位，并留意作品面向谁、属于什么类型。

title: A Product Manager's Experience with Claude Code: How to Build a Semi-Production-Grade Interface Product
title_zh: 产品经理使用ClaudeCode心得：如何构建一个半生产级界面产品
excerpt: How a product manager set up the Claude Code environment from scratch — Windows & Linux, local & cloud — to independently build semi-production-grade, demo-ready UI products.
excerpt_zh: 产品经理如何从零搭建 Claude Code 运行环境，适配 Windows/Linux、本地/云环境，摆脱对研发的基础依赖，自主搭建可演示、可迭代的半生产级界面产品。
